Title: Qwen Studio
Description:
HUGGING FACE MODELSCOPE TECH REPORT FLASHQLA DISCORD
Introduction In this release we are opening the weights of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4. It plays the same role that Qwen3-Next played for Qwen3.5: the hybrid Gated DeltaNet + Gated Attention design introduced at that time has since been used across the Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen3.7 and Qwen3.8 series. We are again releasing the architectural changes early, so that the community can examine them before the full Qwen4 model family is built on top of them.
